Best RTX 2050 Laptops in India: Honest Benchmark Reality & Buying Advice

The RTX 2050 features the same Ampere GA107 architecture as the RTX 3050, but with a 64-bit memory bus instead of 128-bit. At under ₹50,000, it blows GTX 1650 and AMD Vega iGPUs out of the water.

🎯 Quick Buyer Verdict

If your budget cannot exceed ₹52,000, the Lenovo LOQ 15 (15IAX9) RTX 2050 with 100% sRGB screen or ASUS TUF Gaming F15 (70W TGP) are the smartest purchases.
